title: Vampire Vape Pineapple E-Liquid
description: Pineapple by Vampire Vape delivers a deliciously fruity and sweet tropical flavour, with a smooth inhale and an irresistibly exotic aftertaste. It’s ideal for vapers with a sweet tooth seeking a fabulously fruity all-day vape option. This 10ml e-liquid is available in various strengths, with lower nicotine bottles providing a gentler throat hit, and higher strengths offering a more intense experience. This premium e-liquid from Vampire Vape offers an ideal balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, a satisfying throat hit and a discreet amount of vapour. Please Note: That the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG . They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. 10ml bottles of e-liquid remain one of the most popular and versatile ways to enjoy vaping. Each bottle is capable of filling a 2ml pod or tank five times, which makes them far more sustainable and economic than single-use, disposable vapes. Their affordability makes them ideal for experimenting with and changing flavours on the fly, and their compact form makes 10ml bottles easy to carry alongside your preferred vape device. Vampire Vape are one of the most successful and influential e-liquid brands in the UK. They are renowned for the quality and variety of their e-liquids and for their signature flavours, including game-changing e-liquid icons Heisenberg & Pinkman flavours.
